question.problem:
The following table shows the rate $r(t)$, in flour bags per minute, at which a machine makes flour over a period of $75$ minutes.

| $t\,\text{(minutes)}$ | $0$ | $15$ | $30$ | $45$ | $60$ | $75$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $r\,\text{(flour bags/minute)}$ | $30$ | $25$ | $35$ | $40$ | $35$ | $25$ |

Use the right Riemann sum for $r(t)$ over the interval $[0,75]$, with five subintervals, to approximate the number of flour bags made by the machine in $75$ minutes.
question.worked_solution:
First, let's compute the step size $Δt,$ which is just the width of each rectangle. In this case, the endpoints of our interval are $a=0$ and $b=75,$ and there are $n=5$ rectangles, so the step size is

$$
Δt=\frac{b-a}{n}=\frac{75-0}{5}=15.
$$

The area $A$ under the graph can be approximated using the formula

$$
A≈(\overset{\text{heights}}{\overset{⏞}{r(15)+r(30)+r(45)+r(60)+r(75)}})\cdot {{Δt}_{⏟}}_{\text{width}}.
$$

So, we now set up a table with the values of $r(t)$ at each point:

| $t$ | $15$ | $30$ | $45$ | $60$ | $75$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $r(t)$ | $25$ | $35$ | $40$ | $35$ | $25$ |

Now, we obtain the following approximation for the area:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈(25+35+40+35+25)\cdot 15 \\  & =160\cdot 15 \\  & =2\,400\end{aligned}
$$

 

Finally, in the given context, the area under the curve represents the total number of flour bags made by the machine in $75$ minutes.  So, the number of flour bags is approximately $2\,400.$
